units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:1">Targ. Gen. I, 1</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:12">Targ. Prov. XX, 12</cite> <he>אלהא אברי</he>, prob. to be read <he>אלהא ברא</he> as <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 22:2">ib. XXII, 2</cite>.]—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:16">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>ברו עלמא</he> they might create a world.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67a">Ib. 67</cite> <he>לא מצי ברי</he> he (the demon) cannot create. [<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67a">Ib.</cite> <he>ומיברי</he>, <he>ומיברו</he>, v. Ithpe.]
<cite ref="Chullin 93b:1">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>מדלא קא בַרְיִין</he> since they do not grow (develop).
<cite ref="Chullin 46b:10">Ib. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>הדרא בַרְיָא</he> gets well again. [<cite ref="Taanit 21b:16">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>זיל בריא</he>, v. Af.]
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 40:20">Targ. Is. XL, 20</cite>.

senses.gloss: (v. בַּר I ch., Pi. 2) to expel, exile.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 24:24">Targ. Prov. XXIV, 24</cite> (h. text <he>זעם</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 3:35">Targ. II Sam. III, 35</cite> (Var. <he>לאוֹכָלָא</he>, v. <cite ref="E00051"><he>הַבְרָאָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Sukkah 44b:5">Succ. 44ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 3a:11">M. Kat. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>אַבְרוּיֵי אילני</he> to make the trees stronger (facilitate their growth); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 50b:6">Ab. Zar. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>אברויי וכ׳</he>, opp. <he>אוקומי</he> to preserve the trees.
<cite ref="Niddah 47b:50">Nidd. 47ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 97a:7">Yeb. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>אַבְרְיוּהוּ</he> make him grow fat (feed him well).
<cite ref="Taanit 21b:16">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>זיל אַבְרֵי נפשך</he> (ed. <he>בריא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) go and strengthen thyself.
<cite ref="Chullin 112a:7">Ḥull. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>דאבריה</he> (the blood) soaked through the bread.
<cite ref="Chullin 93b:7">Ib. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>דץ ביה מידי דמברי ליה</he> Ar. (ed. only <he>דץ ביה מידי</he>) if he stuck something into it which perforated it (making a passage for the blood).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:4">Targ. Gen. II, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>מן הן דאתבריין</he> (to) where they were created from.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:5">Cant. R. to VIII, 5</cite> <he>וכדון אִתְבְּרִיַית וכ׳</he> now thou hast been created again a new creature (having escaped a great danger).—
<cite ref="Berakhot 54b:4">Ber. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>איברי ליה וכ׳</he> a well was created (arose) before him.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:17">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:13">67ᵇ</cite> <he>ומִיבְּרִי להו וכ׳</he> (not <he>ומיברו</he>, Yalk. Ms. <he>איברי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) and a three years’ calf was created (arose) before them (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 182:1">Yalk. Ex. 182</cite> <he>ומַבְרֵי</he> they created).

senses.gloss: to become strong. Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᶜ מכיון דאִבְּרִי ליביה עלוי וכ׳ since his heart (passion) became so strong over him as to do this (or דאַבְרֵי Af. he allowed his passion to become so strong &c.).

units: <cite ref="Niddah 50b:17">Nidd. 50ᵇ</cite> (explain. the expression <he>תרנגול ברא</he> used by a scholar) <he>דאיבראי ממרה</he> (= <he>שמרדה</he>) that became too wild (uncontrollable) to her owner.
